selections.speaker: narrator
selections.text: THIS WAS ONCE THE CHAPEL OF THE KEEP. INSIDE THE DOORWAY ARE THE DRIED HUSKS OF TWO ORCS, THEIR FACES TWISTED WITH TERROR. A LARGE ALTAR DOMINATES THE SOUTHERN WALL.

selections.speaker: ferran-martinez
selections.text: I AM THE LIFE FORM OF FERRAN MARTINEZ, BOUND WITH THE UNDEAD SPIRITS OF ALL WHO DIE WITHIN THESE WALLS TO GUARD THE KEEP. TELL ME, HAS THE CITY BEEN FREED?
